selectedSops.biological_role: In adults with type 2 diabetes, the tested less-processed whole-grain package reduced daily glucose standard deviation and mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus a nutrient-matched finely processed package over two weeks.
selectedSops.evidence_limitation: A food package, not an isolated grain or fibre effect; unmasked foods, short duration. Concealed randomisation, blinded CGM, initial masked analysis and intention-to-treat models support appraisal.
selectedSops.dietary_input_note: Dietary SOP, not a nutritional capacity requirement.
selectedSops.reader_description: 31 adults with type 2 diabetes; 28 completed. Two-week crossover: intact oats, brown rice and coarse/kibbled bread versus matched finely processed whole-grain products; at least two-week washout.

selectedSops.input: Early eating with front-loaded calories (six-day trial)
selectedSops.biological_role: In a small prediabetes crossover, the tested early, front-loaded eating schedule reduced mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) over six days versus later calorie distribution; mean glucose and several other variability/range measures were inconclusive.
selectedSops.evidence_limitation: Small sample, no washout; timing, eating-window length and calorie distribution cannot be separated.
selectedSops.dietary_input_note: Dietary SOP, not a nutritional capacity requirement.
selectedSops.reader_description: 10 adults with prediabetes and overweight/obesity. Six days of matched weight-maintenance food: 08:00-16:00, 80% of calories before 14:00, versus usual later distribution; randomised crossover without washout.

selectedLifestyle.biological_role: Two weeks of the tested supervised interval-walking programme reduced mean amplitude of glycaemic excursions (MAGE) versus an inactive control period in a small type 2 diabetes crossover trial.
selectedLifestyle.evidence_limitation: Small unmasked trial, baseline imbalance and missing sensor record; oxidative-stress markers did not improve. No blanket superiority to all continuous exercise.
selectedLifestyle.reader_description: 14 adults with type 2 diabetes; 13 usable CGM records. Randomised crossover: ten supervised 60-minute sessions over two weeks, alternating three-minute slower/faster walking; continuous and inactive comparator periods, multiweek washout.

selectedLifestyle.input: Four brief vigorous activity bouts daily (48-hour trial)
selectedLifestyle.biological_role: Four brief vigorous bodyweight bouts daily produced small secondary continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) variability improvements over 48 hours in inactive adults with well-controlled type 2 diabetes; the primary mean-glucose contrast was not significant.
selectedLifestyle.evidence_limitation: Small secondary effects without multiplicity adjustment; short washout permits carryover. Not evidence for gentle walking or lasting clinical benefit.
selectedLifestyle.reader_description: 31 inactive adults with well-controlled, non-insulin-treated type 2 diabetes. Two 48-hour crossover periods: four one-minute vigorous bodyweight bouts daily versus usual activity; at least one hour between bouts, encouraged after meals.
